narrative.overview: A near-black editorial canvas with graphite and steel surfaces, warm-white type, and orange used only as signal. The site should feel authored, technical, and direct—not like a glassy SaaS template.
keyCharacteristics: Hard rules, square geometry, minimal radius, no decorative glow or gradient.
Orange is signal, not a decorative fill system.
Structural borders remain visible at all times.
Motion is brief and structural; reduced-motion preferences disable animation and skip the WebGPU hero shader.
Shipped UI captures only—no invented screenshots or fake metrics.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Signal orange appears on ≤10% of any given screen. It marks action, index, or status—not decoration.

rules.name: The Visible Rule Rule
rules.body: Structural borders must remain visible. Do not soften the grid into borderless cards.

rules.name: The Index Label Rule
rules.body: Section and page kickers use mono uppercase with an orange index prefix where applicable.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. Depth is conveyed through surface color steps and visible rules, never glow or gradient fills.

dos: Do use shipped Playblast captures only (clients.png, invoices.png, review.png, compare.png).
Do keep interactive targets at least 44px where space allows.
Do allow the vgpu shader as a restrained atmospheric layer on page heroes when WebGPU is available and reduced motion is not requested, with flat graphite fallback otherwise.
donts: Don't use decorative glow, gradient fills, or glassy SaaS patterns.
Don't invent testimonials, customer counts, adoption numbers, or performance claims.
Don't show $0 fund metrics, empty activity dashboards, or supporter theater on /fund.
